I need to convert the METHOD to a regular inline function or just inline the logic directly in the main body.

Let me rewrite this without the METHOD, inlining the logic directly in the function block body.

Key points to preserve:
1. cyclicExecution = TRUE → add value every scan
2. trigger rising edge → add value (ignored if cyclicExecution=TRUE)
3. reset = TRUE → reset all state
4. windowSize validation [1,100] → error if out of range
5. windowSizeReached = TRUE when sampleCount >= windowSize
6. average = sum / sampleCount (or windowSize when full)
